About Me

I am a veteran of empathetic inquisitiveness. I bring my empathetic instinct, polished by experience working on academic projects covering all stages of the Double Diamond, into UX Research for Responsible Intelligent Product Development.

As a woman, growing up in a small Indian village, I have always been passionate about understanding people and tinkering to solve their needs. At 9 years old, without any knowledge of design, development, or UX research, I designed a handmade toilet prototype for my 78-year-old grandmother following her cerebral stroke. This innate curiosity ultimately guided me into engineering, rendering me a first-generation woman in technology in my family line.

Beyond the desk

When I work, I am rarely without music. Currently, Celtic songs and Viking music are driving my productivity. Outside work, I enjoy adventure travel and learning things simply because they intrigue me. Here is a picture from my solo trip to Svalbard, 81° north.

Presently, I am learning French and exploring neuroscience-based formulas for adult women’s wellness and productivity, while slowly polishing my skills in improv acting and chess.
